# Sequencer

**Category:** MLP · **Code:**
[`timm/models/sequencer.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/sequencer.py) ·
**Architectures:** 3 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (3 with ImageNet-1k results)

Sequencer replaces self-attention with BiLSTM layers that mix tokens along the vertical and horizontal axes, followed by
channel MLPs.

## Papers

* [Sequencer: Deep LSTM for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.01972)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('sequencer2d_s.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Sequencer2d` with `sequencer2d_s` at 224),
other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.
